from.place: Assertion (3): compare the inverse-limit complex of a K-injective tower with the Roos cone

title: Roos complex computes inverse limit on K-injective towers
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with exact countable products and enough injectives, and let $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)$ be the abelian category of inverse systems [def-weil-inverse-system] in $\mathcal A$. For a K-injective cochain complex [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] $I_\bullet$ of towers, write $P=\prod_n\operatorname{ev}_n(I_\bullet)$ and let $1-s:P\to P$ be induced by the transition maps [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism]. The canonical map from the termwise inverse-limit complex $L^p=\varprojlim_n(I_n)^p$ to the shifted mapping cone $\operatorname{Cone}(1-s)[-1]$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Consequently $L$ and $\operatorname{Cone}(1-s)[-1]$ represent the same object of $D(\mathcal A)$.
